snippet.title: Does The Moon Dream | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Does The Moon Dream is a survival horror game that combines brutal grid-based combat with chilling first person exploration. Search the town of Frozen Pines, where survivors and reality itself have been warped by a twisted presence. Hack your way through, end the nightmare. 

Directional, Grid-Based Combat - Brutal grid-based combat with directional attacking and blocking that requires both quick reflexes and strategic thinking.

Choices Matter - Be careful on you route through Frozen Pines, your actions will affect will affect whether characters live or die.

A Love Letter to PS2 Horror - Inspired by the likes of Killer7, King's Quest 4, and the Silent Hill series, with a unique retro horror aesthetic.

Chilling Monster Encounters - Explore a variety of eerie locations and eldritch beasts as you search for survivors, uncovering the town's mystery.

Coming Soon...
